items.name: Crysknife
items.description: A blade ground from the tooth of a sandworm, sacred to the Fremen.

items.name: Maker Hooks
items.description: Riding hooks forged for calling a sandworm.

items.name: Thumper
items.description: A spike that drums the sand and summons Shai-Hulud.

items.name: Stillsuit
items.description: A full-body suit that recycles every drop of water.

items.name: Water of Life
items.description: A green vial of the spice essence.

items.name: Guild Solari
items.description: A coin bearing the Spacing Guild's seal.

items.name: Fremen Token
items.description: A carved desert stone given to those the Fremen trust.

npcs.name: Atreides Trooper
npcs.description: A soldier of House Atreides watching the gate.
dialogue: Watch the sand, traveller. It moves on its own out there.
House Atreides holds Arrakeen, but not for want of enemies.

npcs.name: Thufir Mentat
npcs.description: A Mentat computing the odds of every outcome.
dialogue: I calculate a nine per cent chance you survive the deep desert.
A mentat cannot lie to himself. That is the whole discipline.

npcs.name: Chani
npcs.description: A Fremen woman weighing spice on a copper scale.
dialogue: Bring me melange and I will remember your face.
The desert takes, but it also pays.

npcs.name: Gurney Smuggler
npcs.description: A scarred smuggler with a ballad on his lips.
dialogue: The Harkonnen patrol the ridge. Thin their numbers.
Every blade sings a different song.

npcs.name: Sietch Elder
npcs.description: An old Fremen who remembers the water before the desert.
dialogue: My people trust tokens, not words.
Walk with the sand, and it will walk with you.

npcs.name: Harkonnen Scout
npcs.description: A Harkonnen scout in ink-black armour.
dialogue: You are in the wrong desert.

npcs.name: Shai-Hulud
npcs.description: A maker, old as the desert itself.

rooms.name: Arrakeen South Gate
rooms.description: The gate of Arrakeen opens onto an ocean of sand. A trooper stands watch.

rooms.name: Palace Courtyard
rooms.description: The courtyard of the Atreides residence, tiled in pale stone.

rooms.name: Arrakeen Market
rooms.description: Spice traders hawk their wares under awnings stiff with dust.

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.description: A quiet room with a cot and a water basin. You could rest here.

rooms.name: Smugglers' Cantina
rooms.description: A low room smelling of spice beer and secrets.

rooms.name: Smugglers' Den
rooms.description: A cave stacked with crates and Harkonnen contraband.

rooms.name: Deep Desert
rooms.description: Dunes stretch in every direction. Something enormous moves beneath them.

rooms.name: Sietch Tabr
rooms.description: A Fremen sietch carved into the rock, cool and echoing.

rooms.name: Sandworm Pit
rooms.description: A bowl of sand ringed by rock. The ground trembles.

quests.description: Bring Chani 2 raw melange from the market.
Defeat the Harkonnen scout in the smugglers' den.
Recover the Fremen token from Sietch Tabr.
